'''Farbor''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Jynni's Virtue]]'', which was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Naz Felyood]]. The freighter crashed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] after attempting to evade an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol. Farbor died on Korriban either by [[Korriban zombie]]s or when [[Babbnod Luroon]] destroyed the ''Jynni's Virtue''.
